# Mirror Trello checklist completion into a Discord thread

**Pattern:** Event -> filter -> thread post · **Level:** Production · **Trigger:** Trello webhook

## What it does
Whenever a checklist item on the board is checked complete, posts a per-card update into a Discord thread named after that card.

## Why it exists
Long checklists (launches, onboarding) are where progress is easiest to lose. Mirroring each completion into a per-card thread gives everyone a live, tidy progress feed without opening Trello.

## Main flow
Trello Board Webhook -> Keep Completed Check-Items -> Extract Check-Item & Card -> Derive Thread & Message -> Post to Discord Thread (failure -> error rail).

## Use it for
- Tracking a launch checklist in one thread
- Mirroring onboarding checklists to a team channel
- A live completion feed for stakeholders without Trello access

## You get
- A grouped, per-card progress log
- Only real completions post — unchecks ignored
- Ideal for long-checklist cards

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Trello API; Discord webhook URL.
Colour key: 🟦 entry · 🟫 app I/O · ⬜ logic · 🟩 output · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
This is event-driven; sample events (a completion, an uncheck to be filtered, and unrelated noise) are pinned so you can test the Filter with no credential. Sample data is pinned on the trigger, so hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow end to end before attaching a single credential. Right-click → Unpin when you go live.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never bundled in a template. Every node that talks to an external service needs its own connection before the first real run — open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Trello API**
Trello → click your avatar → Power-Ups admin → API key; then authorize a token from the same page. n8n's Trello credential takes the API key + token.
_Gotcha:_ The token must belong to an account that is a member of the board, or every call 401s.

**Discord webhook URL**
Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL. Paste it into n8n's Discord Webhook credential.
_Gotcha:_ A webhook URL is bound to one channel. Use a separate webhook/credential per channel you post to.

Set each credential up once; it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Nothing happens when the event should fire**
Cause: The workflow is still a draft, or its trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate it. The manual test URL is different from the production URL.

**A node shows a red triangle right after import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials note).

**Unchecking an item also posts**
Cause: The state condition was dropped from the Filter.
Fix: Keep both conditions: action type is updateCheckItemStateOnCard AND state equals 'complete'.

**Everything lands in one thread / no threads**
Cause: Your Discord webhook target doesn't support the thread name, or all cards share a name.
Fix: Thread names are derived from the card name; make sure the target channel allows threads.

**Discord posts nothing / returns 400**
Cause: The message content resolved to an empty string, or the webhook URL is wrong.
Fix: Discord rejects empty content. Check the upstream expression produced text, and re-copy the webhook URL.

Still stuck? The **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there.

## Design decisions

The Filter checks both the action type and the new state, because Trello emits the same 'updateCheckItemStateOnCard' action for checking *and* unchecking — only the state distinguishes them. Threading by card name (not by item) is the whole point: it turns a stream of completions into a per-card progress log instead of channel spam.

## Practice exercises

Already production-shaped — deepen it:

1. Post a 'all items complete' message when the last item on a card is checked.
2. Include the checklist's overall progress (x/y) by calling Trello for the card's checklists.
3. Fan different boards into different channels using the board name in the payload.

## 🛠 Customize me

Thread naming is in **Derive Thread & Message** (`'Card: ' + name`) — change it to group by board or member instead, and edit the message body there. To also mirror un-checks, relax the **Keep Completed Check-Items** filter and branch on `state`.

## 🔐 Security

Read-only Trello token on the board. Checklist item text and member names post to Discord — use a private channel if items are sensitive. The Discord webhook must target a channel that permits threads (forum or text).
